name: Sources, code and portability
summary: Bringing outside material in and taking memory out: source ingest and distillation, project history, codegraph, export and import.

features.name: Source ingest
features.summary: Writes an agent's summary and entities for a document or URL into pages, plans folder ingests and removes a source.
capabilities: `brain_ingest_source` turns an agent's summary and entities into one `Brain/sources/src-<slug>.md` page
Creates or updates entity pages through the shared intake; its connections list names only existing entities
Re-ingest rewrites the same page; a content-sha256 manifest with contract fingerprint skips unchanged sources
Archives the redacted bytes of a trusted local source at `Brain/.archives/<sha256>.txt`
`brain batch-plan` packs new or modified files into batches (default 1 MiB, 25 files), honouring `.gitignore`
`brain extract` previews HTML and CSV/TSV extraction and the appended byte range since the recorded watermark
Lists every page derived from one exact source file or URL (`brain_search_by_source`)
On confirm, snapshots and deletes pages tracing only to one source (`forget-source`, `brain_delete_by_source`)
limits: Runs no model, fetches no URL and does no OCR: the calling agent supplies the text, summary and entities
Reads text, Markdown, HTML and CSV/TSV; PDF, Office, EPUB and image files are named, not extracted
Ingest itself is MCP-only; the batch plan only plans, and the caller dispatches each batch
With a storage cap set, ingest refuses the write while the vault is at the critical storage tier

features.name: Source distillation
features.summary: Condenses a source into atomic claims whose quotes are checked against the source and cited by block.
capabilities: Takes 1 to 1000 agent-written atomic claims, each optionally citing a source block id `^abc`; runs no model
Checks each quoted span against the cited block, or against the whole source when no block is cited
Strips the quotation marks from an unverified quote and names it in the report
Writes one page per source at `Brain/distillations/dist-<slug>.md`, claims cited as `[[source#^block]]`
Re-distilling rewrites the same page; a byte-identical re-run changes nothing
Stamps a sha256 of the source bytes the quote check read, so a verifier can reproduce it
For a source the vault lacks, stores a verbatim excerpt up to 64 KiB and checks quotes against it
Classifies the source origin; an outside source lands in the quarantine lane the retrieval trust gate reads
limits: A URL-only source with no excerpt verifies no quotes
Quote matching is normalized text containment, not a check that the claim follows from the source

features.name: Project history as memory
features.summary: Git history and code structure become vault records and notes; note history and file mentions are read back.
capabilities: `brain git ingest` reads commits and tags read-only from `<last>..HEAD` into per-device JSONL in the vault
Attributes commits to release tag ranges in one digest note per repository
`brain git find` filters stored commits by file, author, text and date with no live git call
`brain git mine` turns breaking-change markers and reverts into ADR candidates, never touching existing ones
`brain note-history` splits a note's commits into phases on a 72 h gap, each summarized by its commit subjects
`brain architect` turns layout and manifests into overview, decision and module notes in regenerated regions
`brain pre-extract` emits sorted class, function, import and block seeds for TS, JS, Python and HCL
`brain file-context` searches the index with a file's basename and stem; skips files under 1500 bytes
limits: A git ingest run reads at most the 1000 newest commits by default
`note-history` reads the vault's own git repository on each call and stores nothing
`architect` states module relations only from manifest dependencies; it does no import-graph analysis

features.name: Codegraph partner
features.summary: Detects a codegraph index of the code project and reports it, so agents use it for structural code questions.
capabilities: Finds a code project (a `.git` dir plus a manifest) in the working directory and the vault parent's siblings
Runs `codegraph status -j` and reports the index state: no_project, absent, not_indexed, indexed or error
Health gate flags an empty graph, collapsed edges, dangling references, self-loops and a cache-root mismatch
Exits 1 on a failed health gate with `report --fail-on-health`
Lists the declared workspace members of a Rust project from its manifest, without running extraction
`resync --cron-template` prints a cron or systemd recipe: health pre-flight, commit check, re-index, verify
Adds the codegraph check to `o2b doctor` unless `partner_codegraph_disabled` is set
limits: Never installs, initializes or re-indexes codegraph; the printed recipe runs in the operator's own scheduler
Needs the external codegraph CLI and index; nothing from the code graph is imported into the brain

features.name: Export, import and knowledge packs
features.summary: Exports and imports preferences, the knowledge graph, Open Knowledge Format bundles, bank bundles and knowledge packs.
capabilities: `brain export` dumps active preferences as JSON or llms.txt, or session transcripts as JSONL per conversation
`okf-export` writes an Open Knowledge Format folder: manifest, index, concepts, queries, references, log
`okf-import` stages pages under `OKF Review/` as pending; `--trusted` writes them to their recorded paths
`bank-export` writes one JSON bundle of preferences, page link graph, page contracts and the sources dashboard
`bank-import` restores the graph (skip/overwrite/merge) and preferences unconfirmed unless `--trusted-restore`
Writes a byte-stable `graph.json` of pages, links and relations (`graph-export`)
Seals a selected knowledge pack with a per-file sha256 and a pack digest (`knowledge-pack export`)
`knowledge-pack install` checks the sha256 seal, stages pages in `OKF Review/`, restores rules unconfirmed
`knowledge-pack uninstall` removes a pack's stamped items, keeping rules with local evidence and edited pages
Exports are redacted; okf, bank and graph exports skip prompt-derived pages unless `--include-prompt-derived`
limits: CLI only; no MCP tool exports or imports
Bank import does not restore page contracts or the sources dashboard; they are recomputed
Graph import writes page stubs with links and relations, not page bodies
